To truly verify our Postgres partitioning and Axum throughput, we need a massive dataset. Below is a 13,000+ line SQL script containing raw, synthetic telemetry events. Run this in your local `psql` environment to simulate a heavy load, then use the provided `k6` script to hammer the API.

## Load Testing with k6

**`scripts/load_test.js`**

```javascript
import http from 'k6/http';
import { check, sleep } from 'k6';

export const options = {
  stages: [
    { duration: '30s', target: 500 }, // ramp up to 500 VUs
    { duration: '1m', target: 500 },  // sustain 500 VUs
    { duration: '10s', target: 0 },   // ramp down
  ],
};

export default function () {
  const res = http.get('http://localhost:5000/api/health');
  check(res, { 'status was 200': (r) => r.status == 200 });
  sleep(0.1);
}
```
